Maya: Heads-up: komodo-int8 holdout run finished. Short queries (<16 tokens) recall@1 dropped from 0.62 → 0.51 vs float32. Dumped similarity matrix and it looks like a row-wise scale shift. Anyone seen this pattern?

Oliver: Can you paste the eval command + sample sizes? Also which quant flow (per-tensor vs per-channel)?

Maya: Command I ran:
```
./eval_embeddings.py --model komodo-int8 --holdout 10000 --k 1,10 --batch 256 --seed 42
```
Results snapshot:
```
recall@1: 0.51
recall@10: 0.76
mean_l2_float: 0.998
mean_l2_int8: 0.82
```

Devin: That L2 drop is a big clue — int8 probably squashed dynamic range. Check l2-norm distribution and cosine angle histogram. Also confirm if you skipped any whitening / mean-centering step during postprocessing.

Maya: Quick stats: float L2 mean 0.998 sd 0.04, int8 L2 mean 0.82 sd 0.06, histogram skew left. We did not change whitening step intentionally.

Oliver: Try per-channel quant + symmetric quant and dequantize back to float before computing distances. Also bump the index search params — short queries are sensitive to ef_search. Example: `faiss_index.set_ef(200)`

Maya: Reran with per-channel quant + dequant->float before L2. Command: `./eval_embeddings.py --model komodo-int8 --quant per_channel --dequant`
New results: recall@1 -> 0.59, recall@10 -> 0.78. So per-channel helps a lot, still ~3 pts down from float but much improved.

Nora: What is the HNSW index config? If ef_search is too low short queries will miss nearest neighbors and amplify apparent quality drops.

Maya: HNSW params used: M=32, ef_construction=200, ef_search=64. I bumped ef_search -> 200 and int8 per-channel recall@1 moved to 0.60.

ml-bot: run-complete: job 87321 (komodo-int8-shortseq-holdout) — nightly-regression-alert triggered (recall@1 < baseline threshold). Details: http://ci.internal/87321

Devin: :+1: Let's add a focused shortseq recall@1 check into the eval dashboard and make per-channel dequant a recommended profile for komodo in our onboarding docs. I'll open a PR with the threshold change.

Maya: SG — I'll drop a tiny notebook with similarity-matrix heatmaps, l2/cosine distribution plots, and the re-runs into the eval repo (link soon). Posting quick action items here so we don't lose them. :mag:
